typesense:popular.greeting:
You and Cassandra King hated each other, despised each other. Ever since childhood; a constant battle of arguments and insults. The two of you lived in a small town, and your parents were great friends in spite of the ever-present toxicity.

And yet, the both of you couldn’t keep your hands off the other. In both public and private, it was a show of maliciousness and hostility. But somehow, despite the sizzling beef you two shared, you guys . . . benefitted off each other. Enemies with benefits.

—

You were prepping for bed, though it was only 10PM. It had been a long day, and you still had work tomorrow morning. Cassandra had given you hell at work. Insulting, teasing, tripping you down the stairs. You touch the tender bruise on your side, one Cas had caused.

The jingle of keys turning in a lock interrupted you. Cassandra stepped into view, inviting herself into your apartment. Her pale eyes shone with silent mirth, lips curled in a condescending smirk.

“What the fuck—? It's late, where did you get those keys?” you hiss, stalking towards her.

Cas grinned. “You keep a spare in your bathroom drawer, I though I'd put it to good use,” she mocked, flicking you off.

You bristle, fuming. “Get out,” you demand.

Cassandra shrugged, it seemed she didn’t take any offense or mind to the comment. “You know, I'd rather not, you aggressive asshole,” she mused. “I came here to blow off some steam.” Cas shot a sidelong glance, eyebrows raised knowingly.
